# Definition 
**Dysmenorrhea** refers to painful menses.

# Secondary causes 
Secondary causes of dysmenorrhea may arise if given the following presentations:
- Onset > 25 y
- Unilateral pelvic pain 
- No systemic symptoms 
- [Abnormal uterine bleeding](<Abnormal Uterine Bleeding>)

Which may point to the following diagnoses:
- PID 
- [[Endometriosis]]
- Adnexal masses 
- Uterine anomalies
